08-21.title: War Cabinet dissolved
08-21.text: The joint Labour-National War Cabinet was wound up after the end of the Second World War.

08-21.title: 'Smacking' referendum result
08-21.text: Voting closed in the citizens-initiated referendum on parental smacking. About 87 percent voted that a smack should not be a criminal offence, but the law was not changed.

08-21.title: Peter Dunne announces retirement
08-21.text: United Future leader Peter Dunne, MP for Ōhāriu since 1984, announced he would not stand at the 2017 election.
